CHAIRMAN'S ORDERS10.
10a - 10i Adopt
FROM THE COMMITTEE ON MUNICIPAL AND LEGISLATIVE OPERATIONS  - 
Request City Manager consider implementing a City Council budget priority process to 
ensure Councilors are able to provide the City Manager with each of their budgetary 
priorities in a timely and transparent manner, each City Department thru the City 
Manager, as listed in Appendix B of the Rules of the City Council, shall hereby submit a 
semiannual performance evaluation report to the Council for referral to each appropriate 
Standing Committee on or before January 1 of each year. Each performance evaluation 
report shall include the department’s specific, measurable, attainable, relevant and 
timebound (SMART) goals and objectives, as well as their prior year budget 
information. Following the review of the various performance evaluation reports and 
based on public feedback received from residents, Councilors may, on or before 
February 15 of each year, provide their budget priorities and recommendations to the 
City Manager for consideration in preparing the upcoming fiscal year’s budget. Said 
recommendations may include, but shall not be limited to, proposed projects, programs, 
service improvements, operational needs and policy initiatives. After analyzing the 
priorities given by the Councilors, the City Manager, shall submit a preliminary budget 
report to the City Council on or before March 15 of each year for referral to the Standing 
Committee on Finance. Said report shall identify the administration’s budget priorities 
for the upcoming fiscal year and shall include anticipated proposed projects, programs, 
service improvements, operation needs, and policy initiatives that shall be proposed in 
the official fiscal year budget.
10a.
FROM THE COMMITTEE ON MUNICIPAL AND LEGISLATIVE OPERATIONS  - 
That the Rules of City Council of the City of Worcester be and are hereby amended to 
amend Rule 4 to read as follows: Rule 4. Regular Meetings. Regular meetings of the city 
council shall be held weekly on Tuesday evenings at 5:30 o’clock p .m. in the council 
chamber located inside City Hall, unless at a previous meeting, by a majority vote, the 
city council determines another day, time and /or place. Notwithstanding the above, the 
mayor may advance the starting time for any regular meeting to any time no earlier than 
4:00 p.m. to accommodate an extraordinarily long agenda, a request by the city manager 
to schedule an executive session, or for any other suitable reason. In such event the 
mayor shall cause notice of the advanced time to be delivered to each member of the city 
council no later than the time for posting the meeting agenda.

FROM THE COMMITTEE ON MUNICIPAL AND LEGISLATIVE OPERATIONS  - 
That the Rules of City Council of the City of Worcester be and are hereby amended to 
amend Rule 39 to read as follows: Rule 39. Items of Public Interest. At every meeting of 
the city council, under the "public participation" portion of the agenda, the chair shall 
recognize any person seeking such recognition for the purpose of addressing the council 
on any eligible item on the agenda for that meeting both in person and remotely. Any 
person who wishes to speak on more than one agenda item shall combine their testimony 
on all items to one appearance at the microphone. The time for speaking shall not exceed 
two minutes for any one speaker or sixty (60) minutes for all speakers. This privilege 
shall not apply to items “held under privilege .” This privilege shall also not apply to 
items listed on the agenda as pending in the committee on finance and /or ordinances or 
to tabled items.
